act: Child Care, Protection and Justice Act

entries.act: Child Care, Protection and Justice Act (2010)
entries.title: Prohibition of sexual and economic exploitation of children
entries.content: It is an offence to force, procure or allow a child to engage in prostitution or any form of sexual or economic exploitation. A parent or guardian who forces a child into prostitution commits a serious offence. The child can be removed to a place of safety and the offender can be prosecuted.

entries.act: Child Care, Protection and Justice Act / Marriage Act
entries.title: Forced marriage of a child is unlawful
entries.content: Forcing a child into marriage is prohibited. The child has the right to protection. Police, social welfare officers, or a court can intervene to stop the forced marriage and protect the child.

entries.act: Child Care, Protection and Justice Act (2010)
entries.title: Child can be taken to a place of safety
entries.content: When a child is at risk of exploitation, abuse or forced marriage, authorities can remove the child to a place of safety. The child does not have to stay in the harmful home while the case is handled.
